# Group Recipes

> A community-driven recipe platform where food enthusiasts discover, share, and bookmark recipes across global cuisines.

Group Recipes combines a searchable recipe database with social features including user profiles, discussion groups, and personalized bookmarks. The platform emphasizes community contributions and meal planning, featuring recipes from comfort food to international cuisines.

## Key Topics

## Core Features

- [Group Recipes Homepage](http://www.grouprecipes.com): Main hub for recipe search, sharing, and community features
- [Recipe Bookmarks](http://www.grouprecipes.com/bookmarks): Save and organize favorite recipes for meal planning
- [Community Groups](http://www.grouprecipes.com/groups): Browse discussion forums and member communities
- [Member Directory](http://www.grouprecipes.com/people): Discover community members and recipe contributors

## Main Course Recipes

- [Spaghetti and Meatballs](http://www.grouprecipes.com/136238/spaghetti-and-meatballs.html): Homemade spaghetti and meatballs Italian dinner recipe
- [Beer-spiked Potato-cheese Gratin with Apples](http://www.grouprecipes.com/145490/beer-spiked-potato-cheese-gratin-with-apples.html): Beer-spiked potato-cheese gratin with Granny Smith apples recipe
- [Japanese Dinner](http://www.grouprecipes.com/japanese-dinner): Japanese dinner recipes including curry, salmon, and yakisoba
- [Garlic Noodle](http://www.grouprecipes.com/garlic-noodle): Easy garlic noodle recipes for budget-friendly weeknight meals
- [Mushroom Casserole](http://www.grouprecipes.com/mushroom-casserole): Trusted mushroom casserole recipes with ingredient variations
- [Baked Crab Legs](http://www.grouprecipes.com/baked-crab-legs): Baked crab legs seafood dinner recipes

## Dessert & Candy Recipes

- [Tiramisu](http://www.grouprecipes.com/tiramisu): Italian tiramisu dessert recipes with coffee and chocolate variations
- [No Bake Strawberry Cheesecake](http://www.grouprecipes.com/no-bake-strawberry-cheesecake): No-bake strawberry cheesecake dessert recipe variations
- [Vanilla Sauce Bread Pudding](http://www.grouprecipes.com/vanilla-saucebread-pudding): Vanilla bread pudding dessert recipes with sauce variations
- [Old Fashion Fudge](http://www.grouprecipes.com/old-fashion-fudge): Classic old-fashioned fudge candy-making recipes

## Breakfast & Specialty Recipes

- [Easy Breakfast](http://www.grouprecipes.com/easy-breakfast): Easy breakfast and brunch recipes including pancakes and French toast
- [Deer Jerky](http://www.grouprecipes.com/deer-jerky-ingredients): Venison deer jerky recipes with spicy and Hawaiian variations
